question: Who among the following was the Australian Open 2020 women’s singles winner?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sofia Kenin**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sofia Kenin was the Australian Open 2020 women's singles winner**__.

 __
 
• The 2020 Australian Open was a Grand Slam tennis tournament that took place at Melbourne Park from 20 January to 2 February 2020.
 
• It was the 108th edition of the Australian Open.
 
• This included tennis competitions for professional players in singles, doubles, and mixed doubles.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• ** 2020 Australian Open:**

 
 
• Men's singles winner- Novak Djokovic
 
• Men's Doubles winner- Rajeev Ram and Joe Salisbury 
 
• Women's Doubles winner- Tímea Babos and Kristina Mladenovic
